mechanism: AF3-selected native mixed quantization: one joint E16 x H16 codeword, the curvature weight chosen by the structural distortion of the resulting hard SIDs

calls.name: mixed cost of one joint codeword
calls.note: The continuous surface of the mechanism: the cost the assignment is taken over, with the curved codeword already mapped into the ball. It is the only differentiable place the weight alpha lives. The two-dimensional width is a slice of the sixteen-dimensional halves; the formula is dimension-free.

coupling.note: The weight enters the cost matrix the assignment rule consumes, and the two halves of every codeword disagree, so moving the weight can change which joint code is nearest. The measured counterexample: with a Euclidean cost of [1, 4] and a curved cost of [4, 1] the weight 1/4 picks the second code and 3/4 the first.
